matches.preview: Newcastle are slight favourites at home with a 45% win probability, though the margin is modest given Bournemouth's 29% chances. Last season's form shows Newcastle returning to this level after mixed results, while Bournemouth proved competitive throughout with draws and victories. In recent head-to-head meetings Bournemouth have had the upper hand, winning twice in their last five encounters against Newcastle. The model expects a relatively open contest with 60% probability of over 2.5 goals, suggesting attacking intent from both sides may shape the outcome.
matches.preview_zh: Newcastle在主場略佔優勢，勝率為45%，但考慮到Bournemouth的勝率為29%，差距並不特別懸殊。上賽季的戰績顯示Newcastle在經歷了起伏後回到了這一水準，而Bournemouth整季保持了競爭力，有勝有平。在近期交手紀錄中，Bournemouth佔據上風，過去五場對Newcastle的比賽中贏了兩場。分析模型預期這將是一場相對開放的對陣，有60%的機率出現超過2.5球的情況，這表明雙方的進攻意圖可能會影響比賽結果。

matches.preview: The model favours Aston Villa at 55% to win, significantly ahead of Hull at 20% with a 25% draw probability. Villa's closing form from last spring showed real strength, including notable wins over Manchester City and Liverpool. Hull managed just one victory across their final six matches, with three draws and two defeats. Head-to-head meetings between these two sides show little pattern since 2015. The goals market leans marginally to over 2.5 at 52%, with 48% for under.
matches.preview_zh: 模型預測Aston Villa贏球機率為55%，明顯領先Hull的20%，平手機率為25%。Aston Villa上春季末段的狀態展現出真實實力，包括對Manchester City和Liverpool的顯著勝利。Hull在最後六場比賽中僅取得一場勝利，伴隨三場平手和兩場敗績。這兩隊自2015年以來的交手紀錄並無明顯規律。進球數市場略微傾向於超過2.5球，比例為52%，低於2.5球為48%。

matches.preview: Manchester United are the model’s preferred outcome at 44%, compared with an Everton win at 30% and the draw at 27%, giving the visitors a clear but measured advantage. United ended last season unbeaten in six league matches, winning five, while Everton’s final six brought two draws and four defeats. Recent meetings have been less one-sided: United won three of the last five, Everton won two, and three of those matches produced no more than one goal. Even so, the overall total-goals lean is towards over 2.5 goals at 55%, with under 2.5 goals at 45%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型最看好 Manchester United，以 44% 高於 Everton 獲勝的 30% 與平手的 27%，顯示客隊擁有明確但有限的優勢。United 上賽季最後六場聯賽保持不敗，其中贏得五場；Everton 最後六場則是兩場平手、四場落敗。近期交手的差距較小：United 在最近五次對決中贏得三場，Everton 贏得兩場，其中三場的總進球數不超過一球。即便如此，整體總進球數仍較傾向超過 2.5 球，占 55%；少於 2.5 球則占 45%。

matches.preview: Oracle90’s model favours an Arsenal win at 56%, with the draw at 25% and a Chelsea win at 19%. Arsenal ended last season with five consecutive victories, including three 1-0 wins, while Chelsea closed the campaign with four defeats across their final six matches. The recent head-to-head record also supports the home side: Arsenal were unbeaten in the five listed meetings, winning three and drawing two. Those results include a 2-1 Arsenal victory in March 2026. The total-goals lean is narrowly over 2.5 at 54%, compared with 46% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 的模型認為 Arsenal 勝出的機率為 56%，平手為 25%，Chelsea 勝出為 19%。Arsenal 上季以五連勝作收，其中包括三場以 1 比 0 獲勝；Chelsea 則在最後六場比賽中吞下四場敗仗。近期對戰紀錄也對主隊有利：Arsenal 在列出的五次交手中保持不敗，取得三勝兩和。這些賽果包括 Arsenal 在 2026 年 3 月以 2 比 1 取勝。總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率略高，為 54%，低於 2.5 球則為 46%。

matches.preview: Aston Villa are the model’s measured favourite, with a 49% chance of a home win, compared with 26% for the draw and 25% for Nottingham Forest. Villa ended last season with successive victories over Manchester City and Liverpool, scoring six goals across those two matches. Forest, meanwhile, lost only once in their final six league games and recorded three wins, including two away from home. Villa also won three of the past five meetings, while Forest won once and the other match finished level. The total-goals forecast is narrowly tilted towards over 2.5 goals at 51%, with under 2.5 goals at 49%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型經審慎評估後較看好 Aston Villa，主場獲勝機率為49%，平局機率為26%，Nottingham Forest 獲勝機率則為25%。Villa 上季最後兩場比賽接連擊敗 Manchester City 和 Liverpool，並在這兩場比賽合計攻進六球。另一方面，Forest 在最後六場聯賽僅輸一場，並取得三勝，其中兩勝來自客場。Villa 在過去五次交手中也贏得三場，Forest 贏得一場，另一場則以平局收場。進球總數預測略微傾向超過2.5球，機率為51%，低於2.5球的機率則為49%。

matches.preview: The model makes this a finely balanced contest, with Bournemouth narrowly favoured at 38%, compared with 35% for a Brentford win and 27% for the draw. Bournemouth ended last season unbeaten in six matches, recording three wins and three draws, while Brentford won once across their final six fixtures. Recent meetings favour the visitors overall: Brentford won four of the past five encounters, although the latest finished 0-0 at Bournemouth in March. Four of those five meetings produced at least three goals. The total-goals forecast also leans towards over 2.5 goals at 57%, with under 2.5 at 43%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為這將是一場勢均力敵的比賽，Bournemouth的獲勝機率略高，為38%，Brentford獲勝為35%，平手為27%。Bournemouth上賽季最後六場保持不敗，取得三勝三和，Brentford則在最後六場比賽中僅贏得一場。整體而言，近期交手結果對客隊較為有利，Brentford在過去五次交手中贏得四場，不過最近一次於三月在Bournemouth主場以0比0收場。這五次交手中有四次至少出現三個進球。總進球數預測也較傾向超過2.5球，機率為57%，少於2.5球則為43%。

matches.preview: The model strongly favours a Chelsea win at 77%, with the draw at 15% and a Hull City win at 8%. Chelsea ended last season unevenly, losing four of their final six league matches, although their only victory in that run came at home against Tottenham. Hull finished their Championship campaign with a 2-1 win over Norwich, but won only once across their final six matches. The head-to-head history also supports Chelsea: they won each of the five listed meetings between 2014 and 2017, scoring at least twice every time. For total goals, the model leans towards over 2.5 at 66%, compared with 34% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明顯看好 Chelsea 獲勝，機率為77%，平手為15%，Hull City 獲勝則為8%。Chelsea 上賽季收尾表現不穩，最後六場聯賽輸掉四場，而這段期間唯一一場勝利是在主場擊敗 Tottenham。Hull 在英冠賽季最後一戰以2：1擊敗 Norwich，但最後六場比賽僅獲得一勝。雙方交手紀錄也對 Chelsea 有利：在2014年至2017年間所列的五次交手中，他們全部獲勝，而且每場至少攻進兩球。總進球數方面，模型有66%的機率傾向超過2.5球，低於2.5球則為34%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 favours a Crystal Palace win at 50%, ahead of the draw at 26% and an Ipswich Town win at 24%. The home side ended last season without a victory across the six listed Premier League matches, drawing twice and losing four. Ipswich are returning to this level after a Championship campaign in which their final six listed results brought two wins, three draws and one defeat. Crystal Palace also won the two most recent meetings, both by 1-0 scorelines in the 2024-25 season. The total-goals forecast is completely balanced, with over 2.5 goals at 50% and under 2.5 goals also at 50%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 預測 Crystal Palace 獲勝的概率為 50%，高於平局的 26% 及 Ipswich Town 獲勝的 24%。主隊上賽季在所列的六場英超比賽中未嘗勝績，其中平兩場、負四場。Ipswich 經歷英甲賽季後重返此級別，其最後列出的六場戰績為勝兩場、平三場、負一場。Crystal Palace 亦贏得了最近兩次交手，均以 1-0 比分在 2024-25 賽季取勝。進球數預測保持完全平衡，超過 2.5 球的概率為 50%，低於 2.5 球的概率亦為 50%。

matches.preview: Liverpool are the clear model favourite at home, with a 64% chance of victory, compared with 20% for the draw and 16% for a Fulham win. Their closing six matches of last season were uneven, producing two wins, two draws and two defeats, while Fulham ended that campaign with a 2-0 home win over Newcastle after taking four points from their previous five games. Recent meetings have also been competitive: Liverpool won 2-0 in April, but the preceding three encounters brought two draws and a Fulham win. The total-goals forecast leans towards over 2.5 goals at 63%, with under 2.5 at 37%.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型明顯看好主場作戰的 Liverpool，其獲勝機率為64%，平手為20%，Fulham 獲勝則為16%。Liverpool 上季最後六場比賽表現不穩，取得兩勝、兩平、兩敗；Fulham 此前五場拿下四分，並在該季最後一戰於主場以2比0擊敗 Newcastle。雙方近期交手也相當接近：Liverpool 於四月以2比0獲勝，但此前三次交鋒則出現兩場平手，另有一場由 Fulham 獲勝。總進球數預測傾向超過2.5球，機率為63%，少於2.5球的機率則為37%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 makes Tottenham Hotspur the likelier winner at 48%, ahead of the draw at 27% and an Everton win at 26%. That is a clear advantage, though not a dominant one. The latest evidence supplied comes from the end of last season: Tottenham beat Everton 1-0 at home on 24 May, having also won 3-0 away in the previous meeting. Tottenham closed that league campaign with three wins, two draws and one defeat across the six listed matches, while Everton recorded two draws and four defeats. The total-goals view offers no separation, with over 2.5 goals at 50% and under 2.5 goals also at 50%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 認為 Tottenham Hotspur 更有可能獲勝，機率為 48%，領先平手的 27% 以及 Everton 勝的 26%。這是明確的優勢，但並非絕對優勢。最新的證據來自上賽季末期：Tottenham 在 5 月 24 日主場以 1-0 擊敗 Everton，在前一場比賽也曾在客場以 3-0 獲勝。Tottenham 在該聯賽賽季末的六場比賽中戰績為三勝二平一負，而 Everton 則為二平四負。在總進球數的角度來看並無分別，多於 2.5 球的機率為 50%，少於 2.5 球的機率也為 50%。

matches.preview: The model strongly favours Arsenal, giving them a 62% chance of an away win, compared with 14% for Sunderland and 23% for the draw. Arsenal ended last season with five consecutive victories, keeping clean sheets in four of them. Sunderland also finished positively, beating Chelsea 2-1 at home and Everton 3-1 away after two draws. In the most recent meetings, Arsenal won 3-0 at home in February, while the previous match at Sunderland finished 2-2. The total-goals assessment is close, with under 2.5 goals narrowly preferred at 53% and over 2.5 at 47%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明顯認為 Arsenal 較有優勢，其客場獲勝機率為62%，Sunderland 獲勝機率為14%，平手機率則為23%。Arsenal 上季以五連勝作收，其中四場未失球。Sunderland 季末表現同樣正面，在連續兩場平手後，先於主場以2比1擊敗 Chelsea，再於客場以3比1擊敗 Everton。雙方最近一次交手是在二月，Arsenal 主場以3比0獲勝，而此前在 Sunderland 主場進行的比賽則以2比2收場。總進球數的評估相當接近，低於2.5球以53%略占優勢，高於2.5球則為47%。

matches.preview: Brighton and Hove Albion are the model’s clear favourite, with a 53% chance of winning, compared with 22% for Coventry City and 25% for the draw. Coventry are returning to this level after finishing last season strongly in the second tier, winning their final three matches and scoring 12 goals. Brighton’s closing Premier League results were less consistent, with three defeats and two wins across their final five games. Both victories were 3-0, while their last two matches ended in defeat without scoring. There are no previous meetings on record. The total-goals forecast leans narrowly towards over 2.5 goals at 55%, with under 2.5 at 45%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明顯看好 Brighton and Hove Albion，其獲勝機率為 53%，相較之下，Coventry City 的獲勝機率為 22%，平局機率則為 25%。Coventry City 上季在第二級別聯賽以強勢表現作收，最後三場比賽全數獲勝並攻進 12 球，如今重返此級別賽事。Brighton and Hove Albion 在 Premier League 最後階段的成績較不穩定，最後五場比賽吞下三敗並取得兩勝。兩場勝利皆以 3 比 0 結束，但最後兩場比賽均未能進球並以失利收場。目前沒有雙方過往交手紀錄。總進球數預測略微傾向超過 2.5 球，機率為 55%，低於 2.5 球的機率則為 45%。

matches.preview: Manchester City are the model’s measured favourite, with a 45% win probability, compared with 30% for Manchester United and 25% for the draw. United ended last season strongly, winning five of their six listed matches and keeping three clean sheets. City’s final two games brought a draw at Bournemouth and a home defeat by Aston Villa, although they had recorded consecutive 3-0 wins earlier in May. Recent meetings have varied sharply: United won 2-0 in January, while City won the previous fixture 3-0. The total-goals forecast leans towards over 2.5 at 62%, with under 2.5 at 38%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型評估顯示，Manchester City 的勝率最高，為45%，Manchester United 為30%，和局則為25%。United 在上個賽季末段表現強勁，在列出的六場比賽中贏得五場，並有三場未失球。City 最後兩場比賽先是在 Bournemouth 戰平，之後主場不敵 Aston Villa，不過他們在五月稍早曾連續兩場以3比0獲勝。近期交手結果差異明顯，United 在一月以2比0獲勝，而 City 則在前一次交手以3比0取勝。總進球數超過2.5球的預測機率為62%，低於2.5球則為38%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 sees this match as finely balanced. Leeds United are narrowly favoured at 37%, with Newcastle United close behind at 36% and the draw at 27%. Leeds won each of their final three home matches listed from last season, keeping two clean sheets and scoring seven goals. Newcastle’s three listed away games from that period brought two defeats and one draw, with just one goal scored. The recent meetings have varied sharply, including two goalless draws and Newcastle’s 4-3 home win in January. For total goals, the model leans towards over 2.5 at 55%, compared with 45% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90認為這場比賽實力相當接近。Leeds United的勝出機率略高，為37%，Newcastle United緊追在後，為36%，平手機率則為27%。Leeds在上賽季所列的最後三場主場比賽皆獲勝，其中兩場零封對手，共攻進七球。Newcastle在同期所列的三場客場比賽中吞下兩敗，另有一場平手，且僅攻進一球。雙方近期交手結果差異很大，包括兩場零比零平手，以及Newcastle在一月主場以4比3獲勝。總進球數方面，模型認為超過2.5球的機率為55%，高於少於2.5球的45%。
